content_blocks.text: Extension Types matters because Dart programs need predictable behavior, explicit contracts, and examples that can be verified. This topic focuses on wrapping existing representations in a distinct compile-time interface and understanding their limitations. Keep the lesson’s core distinction separate from runtime, SDK, package, or platform details that may vary. When you build on this idea, state your assumptions, try the smallest useful example, and check edge cases before integrating it into a larger project.
